scenes.title: Side hustle money is FIRE money.
scenes.say: Every flip, every craft sale, every side gig moves your retire date. fire counts all of it.

scenes.title: Know your margin before you list.
scenes.say: The fee calculator works out eBay's final value fee, promoted listing ads and real postage, then shows your net profit and return before you list.

scenes.title: Etsy, FB, Mercari, Poshmark.
scenes.say: Switch to Etsy, Facebook Marketplace, Mercari or Poshmark to compare fee structures on the same item, then log the sale in one click.

scenes.title: Sales import themselves.
scenes.say: Connect eBay or your Etsy shop once, and orders flow into your ledger automatically. For Mercari, Poshmark and Facebook, upload the sales export instead.

scenes.title: One ledger. Tax-ready.
scenes.say: The side gig ledger tracks revenue, fees and item cost for every sale, tags each one for taxes, and skips duplicates.

scenes.title: What do I owe?
scenes.prompt: how much should I set aside for taxes on my side gig?
scenes.after: About **${estimatedTaxableIncome}** of resale profit is taxable. The keyboard sold at a loss isn't deductible.
scenes.say: Claude can see it too, so asking what to set aside for taxes gets an answer from your actual sales.

scenes.title: Need a new stream?
scenes.say: And when you want a new income stream, Side Hustle Accelerators rotates ideas with guides and videos to get started.
